Emmett Watson’s Oyster Bar

Emmett Watson and Sam Bryant opened the city's first Oyster bar in 1979. It is cozy and casual spot with fresh oysters, fish and chips with plenty local beers on tap.

1916 Pike Pl, inside the district

The Market's page

No city business licence matched this name at a market address. Daystall craftspeople and farmers trade under the Market's own permits, which the city's licence file does not carry.
